from datetime import datetime
now = datetime.now()
print(now)
print('dayofweek', now.strftime('%A').lower())

from datetime import datetime
import re

# Determine today's day (same timezone as api demo)
today_day = datetime.now().strftime('%A').lower()
print('today_day', today_day)

content = resp_note['content']
# Parse duration_mins for today's day in the note content
pattern = rf"day:\s*{today_day}\s*\n(?:.*\n)*?duration_mins:\s*(\d+)"
m = re.search(pattern, content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
print('match', m.group(1) if m else None)
if not m:
    # Fallback: simple parsing line by line
    lines = [line.rstrip() for line in content.splitlines()]
    dur=None
    cur=None
    for line in lines:
        if line.startswith('day:'):
            cur=line.split(':',1)[1].strip().lower()
        if cur==today_day and line.startswith('duration_mins:'):
            dur=int(line.split(':',1)[1].strip())
            break
    print('fallback dur', dur)
else:
    dur=int(m.group(1))
    print('duration_mins', dur)
    
workout_duration_secs = dur*60
print('workout_duration_secs', workout_duration_secs)

access_token_sp = resp_sp['access_token']

# Fetch all playlist library entries (paginated)
page_index=0
page_limit=20
playlist_entries=[]
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token_sp, query='', is_public=None, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by=None)
    print('library page', page_index, 'type', type(page), 'len', len(page) if isinstance(page,list) else None)
    if not page:
        break
    playlist_entries.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index>50:
        break
print('total playlists', len(playlist_entries))
print('sample', [(p['playlist_id'], p['title']) for p in playlist_entries[:10]])

workout_duration_secs = 85*60

# Evaluate durations for each playlist
best=None
for i,p in enumerate(playlist_entries):
    pid=p['playlist_id']
    title=p['title']
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token_sp)
    songs = pl.get('songs', [])
    total_dur = sum(s.get('duration',0) for s in songs)
    # Some APIs may return duration in seconds; we assume same unit as workout plan (minutes->secs). We'll verify by checking typical values.
    print('playlist', i, pid, title, 'songs', len(songs), 'total_dur', total_dur)
    if total_dur >= workout_duration_secs:
        overshoot = total_dur - workout_duration_secs
        if best is None or overshoot < best['overshoot']:
            best={'playlist_id':pid,'title':title,'total_dur':total_dur,'songs':len(songs),'overshoot':overshoot}

print('best', best)

candidates=[]

    title = p['title']

    songs = pl.get('songs', [])
    total_dur = sum(s.get('duration',0) for s in songs)
    # estimate average duration
    avg = total_dur/len(songs) if songs else 0
    candidates.append((pid,title,len(songs),total_dur,avg))

print('candidates:')
for row in candidates:
    print(row)

# choose playlist meeting duration requirement with minimal overshoot
best=None
for pid,title,nsongs,total_dur,avg in candidates:

        overshoot = total_dur - workout_duration_secs
        if best is None or overshoot < best['overshoot']:
